derivation_method: HMAC-SHA256(domain_string + big-endian-uint64(index), no separate key) -> first 4 bytes as big-endian uint32, mask to 31 bits; skip zero and previously reserved seeds

extra_development_v2.purpose: Group-E diversity seeds; all 20 included; all assigned to training partition

training.rationale: Seed 18 moved from v1 calibration to training: sole positive-label source in v1 must be in gradient training. Extra seeds 1001-1020 all in training for positive-label coverage.

calibration.purpose: F2 checkpoint selection; no gradient training

validation_v2.purpose: F2 offline generalization audit; never training

f4_holdout.purpose: F4 exam only; used only if F3 fails validly

guardrails: Development tools must reject any seed in validation_v2, f3_holdout, or f4_holdout
Training code must reject any seed not in its declared partition
Mixing rows from different seeds across partition boundaries is forbidden
F3/F4 holdout seeds must not appear in any training, normalization, or feature extraction run
